description:
### Motivation, Context and Description

This PR adds logging functionality to the contextual function selection.

Contributes to: https://github.com/microsoft/semantic-kernel/issues/10074

comments.body: I believe record is not recommended due to their perf cost. A regular class should probably be OK here too.

```suggestion
            logger.LogTrace("ContextualFunctionProvider: Functions search results for context {Context} with a maximum limit of {MaxCount}: {Results}",
```
Replaced it with a struct that should be a little bit more efficient than using a class memory-wise.

nit.
Normally I see `null`, curious why is different here.

```suggestion
        ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory = null,
```

nit. Thought `NullLogger.Instance` was already an `ILogger` curious why the cast is needed.

```suggestion
        this._logger = (loggerFactory ?? NullLoggerFactory.Instance).CreateLogger<FunctionStore>();
```

```suggestion
    internal static void LogFunctionsVectorizationInfo(this ILogger logger, IList<FunctionStore.FunctionVectorizationInfo> vectorizationInfo)
```
In this context using null and default is the same.
The functionality is more related to functions than to more generic SK so will keep it in the functions namespace
